description: Opus X unit B4: Copycat calling an Electric move while its user has Charge. Setup turn: Jolteon's Shock Wave hits Bellibolt, whose Electromorphosis gives it `charge`. The turn: Jolteon's Shock Wave at its ally Gastrodon (immune) becomes battle.lastMove; Bellibolt's Copycat calls Shock Wave at a random foe, doubled by Charge, and runMove's AfterMove sees the called Electric move: the charge ends.
